name: Experimental live electronic music performances (Studio DB)
description: Part of Berlin Art Week 2025's Featured programme, this event presents a seamless flow of live performance, cutting-edge sound design, immersive lighting, and experimental video projection. The evening features Manami Sakamoto (Live / AV) from Tokyo with luminous digital artistry and immersive 360° LED light and multi-channel sound; Outro (Juan Barallobres) with experimental compositions; Carlos Villamiza (Live); Ungrid (AV) collective with expansive 3D audiovisual environments; and Jiu-Q (Live), a Japanese ambient jazz artist with improvisational warmth using French horn. The programme transforms the venue's architecture into a responsive stage where music, light, and image move as one.
